title: 1990 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: A dress originally priced at \(\$80\) was put on sale at \(25\%\) off. If \(10\%\) tax was added to the sale price, then the total selling price of the dress was

solutions.text:
The sale price is \(\dfrac34 \cdot \$80 = \$60.\)

The tax is \(10\%\) of \(\$60,\) which is \(\$6,\) so the total is \(\$60 + \$6 = \$66.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: A \(25\%\) discount leaves \(75\%\) of the price
Adding \(10\%\) tax multiplies the sale price by \(1.1\)
